reason: Pi 1.5.2 hands each tool row one mutable ctx.state bag and offers no other per-row storage. Without this write, every render would rebuild the row state and drop its caches.
AssistantMessageEventStream.push is pi-ai's event-emit API, not a collection write. It is the only way to feed a provider stream, and the bench and demo providers need it.
Pi assigns borderColor onto the live editor instance when the theme changes. The test reproduces that host write to prove the rule cache restyles.
